description.alarm: Alarm as soon as the price falls below this. Leave empty for no alarm.

description.note: What you want the card for. Only you see this.
description.nothing-here: Nothing under this filter right now.
description.price-condition: The trend effectively describes English cards in near mint. A German or a played copy trades below it, so the price shown is too high for those.
description.price-etched: Scryfall reports no separate price for etched. The foil price applies there.
description.price-source: Compared against Cardmarket's trend price as Scryfall reports it: English, near mint. A cheaper offer in worse condition or another language does not set the alarm off.
description.price-source-long: The prices come from Scryfall and are Cardmarket's trend prices: an average of recent sales, not the cheapest offer right now.
description.price-staleness: Prices only move when the card catalog is synced. That is also the only moment an alarm is checked.
description.watch-lists: Cards you are still after. Every row tells you how many you already have and what it currently costs.
